svg.title: Kipat card, Layered Depth, back
svg.desc: CR80 85.60 x 53.98 mm, corner radius 3.18 mm. Canvas includes a 3 mm working bleed; FINAL BLEED MUST FOLLOW THE SELECTED VENDOR'S TEMPLATE. Colours are digital references; FINAL PRINT COLOUR MUST BE PROOFED WITH THE VENDOR. Text is outlined Inter (SIL OFL). Plates SPOT_GLOSS / DEBOSS and NFC_SAFETY_ZONE / GUIDES are hidden and non-printing as colour.

rect.data-material: Soft-touch laminated PVC, charcoal flood, debossed plane

rect.data-config: Default = whole card: antenna geometry unknown. Replace with the inlay vendor drawing. No metallic foil, metal or conductive ink inside unless the vendor certifies the build.

rect.data-guide: QR quiet zone (4 modules) - PLACEHOLDER QR, replaced per card
